summary: Federal fishery managers would start analyzing the DNA collected in ocean waters to help inform their decisions, under a bipartisan bill introduced in the U.S. Senate, Alaska’s Republican U.S. Sen. Lisa Murkowski said on Thursday.

title: Gotta love zucchini: Lore and recipes

title: Bears breach fence, mob trash cells at borough landfill
summary: Kodiak brown bears have been sorting through and devouring garbage at the Kodiak Island Borough Landfill this summer, to the point where the Alaska Department of Environmental Conservation is considering penalizing the municipality, after weeks of planning a solution.

title: Special Olympics golf local games (photos)
summary: Kodiak Special Olympics Golf Local Games were held Saturday and Sunday at Bear Valley Golf Course. Athletes and unified partners golfed 18 holes, nine on each day. Level one golfers competed in a skills assessment.
